fusions.name: Brow Shove
fusions.desc: Leans your forehead into the target, dealing 14 damage, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinned to the Rock
fusions.desc: A horned strike that deals 32 damage, ignoring armour, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Won't Budge
fusions.desc: You plant yourself: the damage you take falls by 30% for 12 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, you gain a shield of 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
